# Solvang CA Travel Guide (solvangguide.com)

> Official tourist and visitor guide for Solvang, California and Santa Ynez Valley.

## Core Sections & Events
- [Homepage & Julefest Christmas 2026–2027](https://solvangguide.com/): Official guide to Solvang Julefest (Nov 27, 2026 – Jan 3, 2027), holiday schedule, lights, parade, and hotel stays.
- [Wine & Experiences](https://solvangguide.com/wine-and-experiences): Wine tasting rooms, tours, and culinary spots.
- [Taste of Solvang 2027](https://solvangguide.com/taste-of-solvang-2027): Food festival dates and event highlights.
- [Wine Marathon 2027](https://solvangguide.com/wine-marathon-2027): Half marathon and Santa Ynez Valley running event details.
- [Spring Wine Fest 2027](https://solvangguide.com/solvang-spring-wine-festival-2027): Solvang Spring Wine & Food Festival information.
- [Summer Music 2027](https://solvangguide.com/summer-music-2027.html): Planning guide for possible June–August music events at Solvang Park; official dates, performers, and times are pending.
- [Solvang Danish Days 2027](https://solvangguide.com/solvang-danish-days-2027): Provisional planning guide and sample schedule; event dates and program are awaiting official confirmation.

## 2027 Event Lineup
- March 19–21: Taste of Solvang 2027.
- May 8: Solvang Spring Wine & Food Festival and Santa Ynez Valley Wine Country Marathon (dates shown in the current site guides).
- June–August: Solvang Music in the Park planning guide; official event calendar and performers pending confirmation.
- Anticipated September weekend: Solvang Danish Days 2027 planning guide; final dates and schedule pending organizer confirmation.

## Place
Solvang, CA 93463 — Danish Capital of America in Santa Barbara County. About 45 minutes from Santa Barbara and 2–2.5 hours from Los Angeles via US-101. Downtown is walkable along Mission Drive and Copenhagen Drive.

## Practical facts
- Parking: Use free lots on the Alisal Road edge and behind Mission Drive; walk downtown on festival days.
- Hotels: Compare boutique Solvang and Santa Ynez Valley stays on the interactive hotel map (Stay22 aid=6a77a27277376ac909f8c1d3).
- Tours: Book wine tastings, village rides, and coastal excursions via GetYourGuide (partner_id=Y2EKWLC).
